text: for the props in the hmsc-int world, make a script that will let you get a size comparison to the player model as a static readout so we can get instant validation on size
resolution: Built tools/prop-scale: a static prop-vs-player size readout for the hmsc-int world. New entry cart/hmsc-int/world/propScaleCli.ts measures the player reference from the LIVE stand-pose skeleton (head-top 2.01m, eyes/chest/waist/knee landmarks) rather than a constant, then prints every PROP_KIND_DEFINITIONS kind with height, ratio vs head-top, the body landmark it tops out at, collision footprint diameter vs the physics capsule, and a bar chart with the player line marked in every row — instant validation by reading one table, no editor boot. Supports substring filters, --sort name, and --json. Wrapper follows the tools/oracle pattern (auto-rebundle via tools/esbuild, runs under tools/v8cli, bundle gitignored). docs/game/hmsc.md + _index/records/hmsc.ts updated per the maintenance contract; oracle self-parse verified.
